description: This file defines the ShoppingCartItem class, which represents an item within a shopping cart in the OFBiz e-commerce framework. It includes methods for creating, managing, and validating shopping cart items, supporting features such as product configuration, reservations, availability checks, and integration with product and order entities.

classes.name: ShoppingCartItem
classes.description: Represents an item within a shopping cart, supporting product details, pricing, reservations, configurations, and validation.

classes.name: ShoppingCartItem
classes.description: Represents an item within a shopping cart, supporting product details, attributes, adjustments, contact mechanisms, and item operations such as exploding items for quantity management.

methods.name: ShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Constructor for cloning a ShoppingCartItem.

methods.name: makePurchaseOrderItem
methods.description: Creates a ShoppingCartItem for a purchase order, validating the product and adding it to the cart.

methods.name: makeItem
methods.description: Overloaded methods to create and add a new ShoppingCartItem to the shopping cart with various parameter options, including product details, reservation info, and configurations.

methods.name: checkAvailability
methods.description: Checks if a product is available for the specified quantity and reservation dates, returning 'OK' or an availability message.

methods.name: getPurchaseOrderItemDescription
methods.description: Generates a description for a purchase order item, prioritizing supplier product name.

methods.name: findProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a product entity from the database, verifying purchase category constraints.

methods.name: isValidCartProduct
methods.description: Validates if a product can be added to the cart based on date restrictions and configuration status.

methods.name: addAdjustment
methods.description: Adds an adjustment (GenericValue) to the item and returns its index.

methods.name: removeAdjustment
methods.description: Removes an adjustment from the item, either by adjustment object or index.

methods.name: getAdjustments
methods.description: Returns the list of adjustments applied to this item.

methods.name: addContactMech
methods.description: Associates a contact mechanism ID with a specified contact mechanism purpose type.

methods.name: getContactMech
methods.description: Retrieves the contact mechanism ID for a given purpose type.

methods.name: removeContactMech
methods.description: Removes the contact mechanism ID for a particular purpose type and returns it.

methods.name: getOrderItemContactMechIds
methods.description: Returns the map of contact mechanism purpose types to contact mechanism IDs.

methods.name: getIsPromo
methods.description: Returns whether this item is a promotional item.

methods.name: setIsPromo
methods.description: Sets the promo status for the item.

methods.name: getAlternativeOptionProductIds
methods.description: Returns the list of alternative product IDs for this item.

methods.name: setAlternativeOptionProductIds
methods.description: Sets the list of alternative product IDs.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this item with another based on multiple attributes including product ID, reservation details, attributes, configurations, promo status, and order item attributes.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Product entity, loading it from the database if necessary.

methods.name: getParentProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the parent Product entity for the current product, if applicable.

methods.name: getParentProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID of the parent product, if any.

methods.name: getOptionalProductFeatures
methods.description: Returns the optional features for the product.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Delegate object used to access entity data.

methods.name: explodeItem
methods.description: Splits a cart item into multiple items based on quantity, cloning adjustments appropriately.
